sharedInstructions: Preserve-mode article preparation for https://jas-law-astro-review.netlify.app/. Source press-coverage articles live at /media-articles/<slug>/ and are classified as posts. Shared setup: src/content.config.ts now declares a separate 'media' collection (glob base src/content/media, schema: title and description required; pubDate, author, image, imageAlt, sourceName, sourceAuthor, sourceUrl, sourcePath, draft (default false), ogImage, canonicalUrl optional). Do not put press articles in the blog collection. Layout: src/layouts/MediaArticleLayout.astro wraps BaseLayout and renders the press-coverage design observed on the source (navy hero with breadcrumb, source label, h1, Read the full article button, stats strip, white article card with 'Source: author | outlet' line, Press Coverage chip, image, body, back link, sidebar with confidential-defense CTA, more coverage and practice areas, closing CTA band). It marks the article with data-mdx-file=src/content/media/<entry>.mdx and data-mdx-type=media. Route: src/pages/media-articles/[...slug].astro maps each media entry id to /media-articles/<id>/ via getStaticPaths and renders it with render(entry). Placeholder files for the 19 requested media-articles paths were deleted so they do not shadow the route. Entry rule: targetPath is src/content/media/<slug>.mdx where <slug> is the last path segment; the entry id therefore equals the slug. Frontmatter per entry: title (exact source h1), description (source meta or lead sentence), image (exact source image URL when present), imageAlt, sourceName (outlet credited in the source), sourceAuthor (byline from the source credit line), sourceUrl (the 'Read the full article here' original link), sourcePath (the original /media-articles/<slug>/ path with trailing slash). No pubDate was in the source evidence, so do not invent one. Body: the source excerpt paragraphs as captured, plus nothing invented. The source pages carry robots noindex; the new route is indexable unless the owner decides otherwise (unresolved). Representative entry src/content/media/ag-drops-charges-against-northfield-police-lieutenant.mdx was written as a template; the entry worker should verify it against the source and rebuild. Listing /media remains owned by the page worker and was not changed; its links point at these routes.
